scripts.build:sanctuary: env -u VITE_API_URL -u VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY -u VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY -u VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST vite build --mode sanctuary --outDir dist-sanctuary
scripts.deploy:sanctuary:
npm run build:sanctuary &&
# In 2026, a foreign ScaleMate PostHog token polluted its analytics for months; inspect the built artifact before publishing.
node scripts/assert-prod-bundle.mjs dist-sanctuary &&
rsync -az --delete dist-sanctuary/ hetzner:/tmp/sanctuary-new/ && ssh hetzner "sudo rm -rf /var/www/sanctuary.bak && sudo mv /var/www/sanctuary /var/www/sanctuary.bak && sudo mv /tmp/sanctuary-new /var/www/sanctuary && sudo chown -R caddy:caddy /var/www/sanctuary 2>/dev/null || true"
